competitors.name: Banquet / Conagra Brands
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Banquet launched frozen MEGA Crispy Chicken Tenders in Original and Spicy varieties. The 22-ounce bags contain about 11 tenders, provide 16 grams of protein per serving, support air-fryer prep and carry a $7.49 suggested retail price.

competitors.name: LesserEvil
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported LesserEvil rolled out Cheezmos Puffs nationally at retailers including Whole Foods Market, Sprouts Farmers Market and Kroger. The USDA Organic, non-GMO, gluten-free puffed snack line uses organic cheddar, contains 130 calories per serving and retails at $5.99 for a 6.5-ounce bag.

competitors.name: Market 32 / Price Chopper
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Market 32 and Price Chopper launched a fall value campaign across all 128 stores, lowering prices on more than 1,000 grocery staples, adding bright-yellow lower-price tags, shifting AdvantEdge Rewards to 2% back through Nov. 7 and rolling out weekly deep deals.

trends.magnitude: 16g protein per serving in a mainstream frozen meal component
trends.context: Frozen brands are pairing convenience with protein claims and air-fryer prep. Premium frozen pizza should expect more shopper comparison against protein-forward, customizable freezer items.

trends.topic: Better-for-you snack brands scaling in premium grocery channels
trends.magnitude: National rollout at Whole Foods, Sprouts and Kroger
trends.context: Clean-label and minimally processed cues are continuing to win broad retail distribution. This reinforces the need for clear ingredient and process claims in artisan frozen products.

Regional grocers are making price cuts and loyalty savings highly visible ahead of fall and holiday shopping. Premium frozen brands need value communication that can survive retailer-wide price messaging.
